comparison.objective: Perform prove–test–prove voltage-detector procedure versus commission a mechanical damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Button sequencing, temporal indicator interpretation, probe contact, and conditional safe stopping versus tool engagement, fine rotary tuning, relocking, and guarded mechanical cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Detector proves before and after bar contact, or safely aborts on tester failure, versus two non-bottoming stops and stable adjustment.
comparison.reason: Both require physical controls and verification, but electrical procedural reasoning is materially different from dynamic damping calibration. Candidate response and lock-verification details remain incomplete.
